latest.notes_en: The arrow keys, the game controller and Gaze Control now reach every tile, card, game, story and Progress panel, with a ring that shows where you are, in the app and in the web app.
latest.notes_fil: Naaabot na ng mga arrow key, ng game controller at ng Gaze Control ang bawat tile, card, laro, kuwento at bahagi ng Progress, at may kuwadrong nagpapakita kung nasaan ka, sa app at sa web app.
